exercise.name: Incline Machine Fly
library_steps: Sit back on the incline seat and hold the handles, elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles up and together over your upper chest.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.
exercise.one_line_summary: Reclined on a 30 deg seat, vertical handles. Picture 1: arms open level with the shoulders, elbows softly bent; picture 2: arms brought together over the upper chest with the same elbow bend.

setup.target: Back pad ~30 deg; handles level with the shoulders when the arms are open.
Soft fixed bend (~20 deg) the whole way.

movement.start: -10 deg (arms open, a little behind the chest line)

muscles.emg: Fly = pectoralis with a fixed elbow (S1); 30 deg incline biases the clavicular head (S2, S3).
muscles.role: Library primary 'chest'; incline so upper chest primary.
muscles.surface: Upper front of the chest below the collarbone.

muscles.emg: Sternal head works in horizontal adduction (S1).

mistakes.why_it_matters: Turns the fly into a press (S1).

sources.citation: Solstad TE, Andersen V, Shaw M, et al. A comparison of muscle activation between barbell bench press and dumbbell flyes in resistance-trained males. J Sports Sci Med. 2020;19(4):645-651.
sources.what_it_gave: Bench press activated pectoralis, anterior deltoid and triceps 8-81 % more than the dumbbell fly; in the fly the pec works with a fixed elbow.

sources.citation: Rodriguez-Ridao D, Antequera-Vique JA, Martin-Fuentes I, Muyor JM. Effect of five bench inclinations on the electromyographic activity of the pectoralis major, anterior deltoid, and triceps brachii during the bench press exercise. Int J Environ Res Public Health. 2020;17(19):7339.
sources.what_it_gave: Bench inclinations 0-60 deg: 30 deg gives the highest clavicular pectoralis activity; anterior deltoid rises with incline.

sources.citation: Lauver JD, Cayot TE, Scheuermann BW. Influence of bench angle on upper extremity muscular activation during bench press exercise. Eur J Sport Sci. 2016;16(3):309-316.
sources.what_it_gave: Upper pectoralis 122-124 % MVIC at 30 and 45 deg incline (mid concentric); lower pectoralis ~100 % at -15 deg decline, 72 % at 45 deg.

clip_check.target: -10 deg (arms open, a little behind the chest line) -> 90 deg (arms together in front) (start -20-10, end 80-100)

clip_check.check: Machine parts meet the hands/feet; levers keep their length
clip_check.target: moving rod lengths equal at start and end (+-1 cm)
